name: Warmaster Laggrond
summary: At Alterac Valley's entrance, Warmaster Laggrond prepares Horde fighters for the Frostwolf clan. From the valley entrance in the Alterac Mountains, he calls warriors to aid the Frostwolves.

sections.title: Frontline Commander
sections.body: Warmaster Laggrond directs the Horde's fight against the Stormpike Expedition at Alterac Valley's entrance. The cold is bitter there. He accepts only capable fighters to represent the Frostwolf clan and the wider Horde.

sections.title: The Path of Honor
sections.body: Warmaster Laggrond sends new combatants through the Proving Grounds before they enter battle. As warriors fight across the frozen peaks, he measures their standing. Those who earn renown among the Frostwolves receive his honor.

faq.answer: Warmaster Laggrond is near the Horde encampment at Alterac Valley's entrance portal, in the snowy passes of the Alterac Mountains north of Hillsbrad Foothills.
Warmaster Laggrond recruits fighters for the Horde's war in Alterac Valley. He tests new combatants and honors those who earn standing with the Frostwolf clan.

faq.q: What is the Proving Grounds quest?
faq.answer: Warmaster Laggrond asks prospective recruits to retrieve a Frostwolf banner from the Wildpaw Den in Alterac Valley. The trial tests their resourcefulness before they join the campaign.

faq.q: Why is the Horde fighting in Alterac Valley?
faq.answer: The Frostwolf clan claims Alterac Valley as its home after exile during the First War. The Stormpike Guard, an Alliance dwarven expedition, has pushed into the region in search of relics and territory. Their arrival sparked a bitter territorial war.

faq.q: Can Alliance players interact with Warmaster Laggrond?
faq.answer: No. Warmaster Laggrond is a devoted Horde champion. He attacks Alliance trespassers who approach his mountain outpost.

angles.text: Warmaster Laggrond is your first contact for the Alterac Valley war effort. He recognizes your battlefield achievements for the Frostwolf clan.
As an orc, you answer Laggrond's summons to defend the Frostwolf clan's ancestral refuge from dwarven intrusion.
As a warrior, you face Laggrond's tests of frontline courage. They prove you can hold against heavy dwarven armor and vanguard charges.
